name: qkd_ahub_die-hp1-COMMIT
purpose: KV/system die attention hub PARENT ot_qkd_ahub_die (VIS-ROM QKV-07): core hd3 + 4 ot_nhb_zh + 4 ot_nhb_pbst + 4 ot_nhb_pvlg + ot_qkh_recip_leaf (all CLOSED), 14 clock entries (6 CTS roots carry the composition's relay flops), slot 1,175.04 x 760.32 unchanged

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qkd_ahub_die u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DQKD_AHUB_RLY_CLK --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_core.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles_bb.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_recip_leaf_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_die/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_die/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_die --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qkd_ahub_die --macro-view physical/ref_tile/nhb_pbst_ref/views/ot_nhb_pbst --macro-view physical/ref_tile/nhb_pvlg_ref/views/ot_nhb_pvlg --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_zh_m5/views/ot_nhb_zh --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_core/views/qkd_ahub_core --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkh_recip_ref/views/ot_qkh_recip_leaf > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: new parent kit (the hub parent was never hardened: q8 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD with one cluster clock over 12 hard tiles); per-child clock entries, core in the Z row centre
